name: forever
evidence: Watcom cstrt386 BEGTEXT: int 3 then jmp short forever, the trap at the start of code

name: ___begtext
evidence: Watcom cstrt386 ___begtext at offset 3 of BEGTEXT, nop padding; the start-up code at start references it (fixup)

name: GetCtlAvailMask
evidence: returns mouse present (bit 0) and joyslotmask bits 0-3 (bits 1-4); SetupControllers stores it in ctlavailmask

name: DetectControllers
evidence: clears joyslotmask/mousepresent; MouseInit and a first mouse poll only once (mousechecked); joyslotmask = DetectJoysticks()

name: ReadKeyBinding
evidence: (Ctrl, Alt, binding index, bits, &pad): binding entry {needs Ctrl, needs Alt, scan code word} in keybindings; ORs the bits when KeyDown with the modifier held

name: ReadSharedKeys
evidence: clears the pad and reads key bindings 0 and 1 into bits 0-1; ReadControllerPads starts every controller pad from this

name: MapPadDirection
evidence: pad bits 2-5 through dirmaptab row (0-7 from sub_619E2); no callers, ReadControllerPads has it inline

name: ReadKeyboardPad
evidence: same job as 95PC ReadKeyboardPad: keyboard to pad (bindings 2-11 buttons and 8 directions, double tap, team extra keys); ReadControllerPads device 40h

name: ReadKeyboardPadEnter
evidence: ReadKeyboardPad(pad, 1) plus Enter -> pad bit 7; no callers, inline copy in ReadControllerPads

name: ReadMousePad
evidence: same job as 95PC ReadMousePad: mousepollfn, direction from screen zones of mousex/mousey (640x480 or 320x200), buttons; ReadControllerPads device 2

name: ReadJoyPad
evidence: same job as 95PC ReadJoyPad: (slot, &pad, team) direction and buttons from the slot byte of joyrawbits, double tap; ReadControllerPads devices 4/8/10h/20h

name: SetupControllers
evidence: same job as 95PC SetupControllers: controller devices and cont1team (0 none, 1 home, 2 away) from the setup, recentres the mouse, clears the input queue

name: ReleaseControllers
evidence: clears ctlrecs, mouse range back to mousewidth x mouseheight and centred, clears the input queue; called next to SetupControllers

name: ReadControllerPads
evidence: for each ctlrecs entry of type 1: ReadSharedKeys + device dispatch (2 mouse, 4-20h joystick slots, 40h keyboard), direction map, pad stored in the record

name: FlushControllerInput
evidence: clears the four ctlrecs pads and the input queue (or calls sub_13338 when word_114CE0 bit 0)

name: AnyInputPressed
evidence: same job as 95PC AnyInputPressed: 1 mouse button, 2 joystick button (joyrawbits 30h per slot), 3 key (GetKey)

name: GrLink
evidence: Gravis GrIP SDK GrLink(image, size): "DB" header, nibble-coded offset/size/checksum, DPMI DOS memory and code descriptor, far call with ax 8490h; EXE has GRIP.GLL and Advanced Gravis strings

name: ReadJoysticks
evidence: writes joyrawbits; called before joyrawbits is read (ReadControllerPads, AnyInputPressed)

name: DetectJoysticks
evidence: its result is stored in joyslotmask (DetectControllers), bits 0-3 used as joystick slots

name: MouseSetPos
evidence: same code as 95PC MouseSetPos: (x, y) stack args -> mousex, mousey

name: MouseSetRange
evidence: (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) stack args stored as the clamp limits the mouse poll uses; 95PC sub_B2E1B

name: MouseInit
evidence: int 33h reset, range and position from mousewidth/mouseheight, installs mousepollfn, returns the mouse state (0 none); 95PC sub_B2F22

name: KeyDown
evidence: (scan code on stack) returns the byte of the keyboard state table; 95PC sub_B2CBE

name: GetTicks
evidence: same code as 95PC GetTicks: mov eax,[tickcount]; ret

name: GetKey
evidence: keyboard handler ah=1 (key waiting?) then ah=0 (read), 0 when none; 95PC sub_B39D0

name: joyslotmask
evidence: = DetectJoysticks(); bits 0-3 tested by GetCtlAvailMask as joystick slots

name: mousepresent
evidence: set to 1 when MouseInit returns nonzero; GetCtlAvailMask bit 0

name: mousechecked
evidence: DetectControllers calls MouseInit only while 0, then sets 1

name: ctlavailmask
evidence: same role as 95PC ctlavailmask (bit 0 mouse, then joysticks): GetCtlAvailMask result, bit 0 tested before mouse calls

name: homekeytime
evidence: GetTicks()+18 after the home-team (flag set) bindings 0Ch-0Fh, 14h are read; not read again before

name: awaykeytime
evidence: the same for the away-team bindings 10h-13h, 15h

name: kbdtaptime
evidence: keyboard double tap: GetTicks()+10 when the direction is let go; same direction before it sets pad bit 20

name: joytaptime
evidence: joystick double tap time, dword per slot (+12 ticks)

name: kbdtapstate
evidence: keyboard double tap state: 1 direction held, 0 released

name: joytapstate
evidence: joystick double tap state, dword per slot

name: keybindtab0
evidence: key binding table (4 bytes per binding), keybindings when byte_17CA21 bit 7 is clear

name: keybindtab1
evidence: key binding table used when byte_17CA21 bit 7 is set

name: dirmaptab
evidence: 11 bytes per row, indexed by pad direction (0-10), row from sub_619E2 (0-7)

name: grlinked
evidence: GrLink returns 0 while set, sets it to 1 after the library link call succeeds; GrUnlink clears it

name: cont1team
evidence: same role as 95PC cont1team/cont2team (0 none, 1 home, 2 away), here a word per controller, set by SetupControllers

name: mousex
evidence: 95PC mousex: MouseSetPos x, compared against the screen zones in ReadMousePad

name: mousey
evidence: 95PC mousey

name: mousewidth
evidence: MouseSetRange xmax and MouseSetPos x/2 in ReleaseControllers and MouseInit; 95PC dword_D3044

name: mouseheight
evidence: MouseSetRange ymax and MouseSetPos y/2; 95PC dword_D3048

name: mousepollfn
evidence: 95PC mousepollfn: MouseInit stores the poll routine, called before reading mousex/mousey and the buttons

name: joytapdir
evidence: joystick double tap: last direction, dword per slot

name: curpad
evidence: the pad ReadControllerPads builds before storing it in the controller record

name: kbdtapdir
evidence: keyboard double tap: last direction

name: ctlrecs
evidence: 4 records of 7 bytes: type byte (1 read here), device word, pad dword (SetupControllers, ReadControllerPads)

name: keybindings
evidence: pointer to keybindtab0 or keybindtab1, set by SetupControllers, read by ReadKeyBinding

name: joyrawbits
evidence: same role as 95PC joyrawbits (sampled joystick bits), here a byte per GrIP slot (bits 0-3 direction, 4-5 buttons)

name: grlinkhdr
evidence: 14 bytes copied from the start of the GrIP code by GrLink; holds grentry

name: grentry
evidence: far pointer (offset, selector set to grcodesel) GrLink calls with ax 8490h

name: grdossel
evidence: selector of the DPMI 100h DOS block (freed with DPMI 101h)

name: grcodesel
evidence: descriptor from DPMI 0, base/limit/rights set to the DOS block as code
